name: Remote Rooted Single-Clause Pivot Tower
definition: Let $B_0$ be the normalized 289-concept rooted factor, put $K_0=(B_0\setminus\{1084\})\cup\{604\}$, and take compatible repairing tips $\alpha_0=128$, $\delta_0=290$. Recursively set $B_{j+1}=\mathcal S(B_j;\alpha_j,\delta_j)$ and $K_{j+1}=\mathcal S(K_j;\alpha_j,\delta_j)$ by paired-square transfer, with $\alpha_{j+1}=(\alpha_j,11)$ and $\delta_{j+1}=(\delta_j,11)$.
parameters: For $j\ge0$, both families have $(581\cdot3^j-3)/2$ concepts, dimension $12+2j$, and VC dimension $3+j$.
properties: $(B_j,0)$ is a rooted factor and $K_j$ peels to zero; every proper root-preserving pc-minor of either family peels to its root. Their shadows coincide and their signed presentations differ only on the four-coordinate support $\{5,6,9,10\}$, with antipodal omitted traces. They agree through Hamming radius $j+4$ about zero, and their nearest difference is at distance $j+5$.
